mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and increased market volatility, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 in a month indicates strong economic growth, boosting investor confidence and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 300,000.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where GDPC1 declines by more than 1% QoQ.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 3.5%, the tight labor market and high interest rates create a drag on economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tight monetary policy with low unemployment
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5% and UNRATE < 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals increased economic activity and supply-side strength, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO increases by more than 2% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) for two consecutive months signals a weakening in the housing market and broader economic demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where HOUST declines for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE increases by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) growth is negative and retail and food services sales (RSAFS) are declining, it indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 QoQ growth < 0 and RSAFS MoM decline
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where GDPC1 QoQ growth is negative and RSAFS declines month-over-month.
